name: Proton Drive
description: Open Proton Drive or search a locally synced Drive folder
author: spotty
help:
Optional Proton Drive trigger

Installing adds the `drive` trigger and a Proton Drive row under Settings → Search → Services and integrations. `drive` opens drive.proton.me in your default browser.

In Settings you can choose which signed-in Proton account to open and, optionally, a local folder you already keep in sync with Proton Drive (for example with rclone). With a folder set, `drive <name>` searches file and folder names inside it and opens matches locally.

Proton has no official Linux Drive client, and Spotty does not sync files itself. Sign-in happens on Proton's website; Spotty never sees or stores Proton credentials. Uninstalling removes the trigger only and leaves your files untouched.
